data.body: Epic complete: all 17 planned children plus 1 discovered regression fix closed and landed on main through Gerrit (LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 on every change). Landed: BLOCK-verdict reuse; DET-floor short-circuit; blocking clarity floors P10/P11; edit/claim --review flags; Pass-1 per-call usage accounting; optional genai-prices costing; Pass-1 warm-then-fan-out; shared plan prefix + exhaustiveness directive; mid-review cancellation on own-material drift; DET pre-gates for T13/T14/removal-rationale/asserted-capability (ADR 0034 amended); T3/T10/T5c/G7 blocking enablement with grounded rubrics; T1 web grounding; docs-reviewer surfacing fix; T11 portable persistence constraint; coaching moves in the plan guide. Follow-up filed: bug 30a2 (container output-token scaling), discovered during this epic's own close. Analysis provenance: ticket 696a.
